sermon.title: Before the Throne - February 14, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: The world builds costly temples, but your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit, bought with Christ’s blood. One day you stand before the throne—just you and God. Live to please Him like Abel, Enoch and Moses, and pledge allegiance to the Lamb.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts; and through it he being dead still speaks. By faith Enoch was taken away so that he did not see death, “and was not found, because God had taken him”; for before he was taken he had this testimony, that he pleased God. But without faith it is impossible to please Him, for he who comes to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.
Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.

By faith Moses, when he became of age, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter, choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the passing pleasures of sin, esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

faqs.question: What did the tallest building cost?
What happens if anyone defiles God’s temple?
What does “my body, I’ll do what I want” reject?
faqs.answer: What He did to purchase you.

faqs.question: Is there marriage in the resurrection?
faqs.answer: No—they neither marry nor are given in marriage.

faqs.answer: Drugs or alcohol to get you through.
